Manage choices

Set up single sign-on

Single sign-on lets your team open Acme with the account they already use at work. Set it up once for the whole workspace.

Create the connection

Open Settings, choose Security, and select Add connection. Paste the metadata address of your identity provider into the form.

  1. Copy the sign-in address from your identity provider.
  2. Paste it into the Metadata address field.
  3. Select Save and wait for the green status mark.

Test the sign-in

Open a private window and visit the workspace address. You should land on the sign-in page of your identity provider, and return to Acme after you sign in.
